runSummary.note: Fresh 11.9.2026 19:33 sweep actually searched 11 source families: Profesia, direct-company careers, LinkedIn Jobs public index, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera/Zoznam, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. No new promotion-grade unique hit cleared location, language, skill, economics and trust gates. Kariera's current Bratislava administration inventory includes Office Manager 1750-2000 EUR and Executive Support Specialist 1500-1600 EUR, but detailed language/skill evidence was not strong enough for promotion in this run. LinkedIn returned mostly stale or language-heavy customer-support listings. StartupJobs surfaced Elasticr IT Support Specialist L2 (42-52k CZK, Havlickuv Brod, remote/on-site/hybrid), but Slovakia-from-home eligibility is not proven and the role is L2. Upwork produced one notably close Worldwide candidate: Virtual Assistant - Email, Social & Content Build (Mailchimp, Canva, WordPress), 8-15 USD/h, 4-6 h/week, less than 5 proposals, active client with 53k USD spend; it remains verification-only because hands-on Mailchimp, HTML email editing, Squarespace/Canva/social-creative evidence and English communication burden are not yet demonstrated strongly enough. Facebook public indexing produced 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Application friction score
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Estimate the practical effort needed to apply before ranking equal-fit opportunities: portfolio samples, custom homework, mandatory video, English-written application, platform credits/connects and long questionnaires. This avoids wasting time on marginal opportunities whose application overhead is disproportionate to expected value.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Client responsiveness recency signal
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: For freelance sources, capture last-viewed recency, interviewing count, hires and client spend alongside proposal count. Prefer jobs recently viewed by established clients and deprioritize abandoned listings, improving reply probability without changing the core skill/location gates.
